title: PCGMon 2.0
description: Modpack to join my cobblemon server
body:
Welcome to PCGmon 2.0 — a Cobblemon server built to feel alive.


If you want a place to actually play long-term (not just catch a few mons and dip), this is it.

IP: pcgmon.my.pebble.host
✅ Modpack required to join

🔥 Highlights:
Exclusive Sinister Fakemon (server-only)
Events + community-driven server updates
Safari World with zones for focused spawns
Upgraded, themed Raid Dens
Custom questline + progression content
Underground digging mini-game
EV training area
Relaxed, fair economy + casual vibes
